_source: District coordinates, built 25 Oct 2026 (UTC) for the rainfall signal only. Mostly GeoNames (www.geonames.org, CC BY 4.0): the district capital's populated-place point, matched by name within the region (GeoNames admin1 code), or the district's ADM2 point when the capital was not found. Five capitals not in GeoNames were looked up once on OpenStreetMap Nominatim (data (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0, https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright). 'method' and 'candidates' record how each was matched; where several places share a name the most populous one in the region was taken. Approximate: one point per district, not the farm. Not checked on the ground.
